text: すこし　やすんで　いったら　どうかしら…？

structure.jp: すこし　やすんで　いったら
structure.en: if you rested a little before going

patterns.name: 〜たらどう
patterns.span: いったら　どうかしら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb followed by どう is a gentle way to suggest something: 'how about doing it?'. かしら is a soft, womanly 'I wonder'. いったら　どうかしら = 'why not go after that, I wonder?'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: やすんで　いったら
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb followed by いく means do that thing first and then go. やすんで　いったら = 'if you rest and then go'.
